process: president elected by an electoral college of both Houses of Parliament for a 4-year renewable term; following legislative elections, the president usually appoints the leader of the majority party or leader of the majority coalition as prime minister; the prime minister recommends the deputy prime minister
results: Jeffrey Davidson BOSTIC elected as the country's second president
cabinet: Cabinet appointed by the president on the advice of the prime minister
